messages:
mohammed: Heads-up — 06:30 UTC we saw a ~35% variance in tokens/sec across eu-west GPU pods for the small-chat fleet. some pods peaked at 6.8k tps, others stayed ~4.5k. warmup cycles looked noisy and prefix-cache hit rate dropped.
elaine: ugh. any correlation with recent canary or infra churn?
mohammed: no direct canary. network egress in eu-west-2 had a brief spike (NET-THROTTLE events) around the same window. pod CPU was low, GPU utilization skewed. looks like many short-lived requests caused KV-cache misses and repeated KV warms.
jason: can you paste the quick sim you ran for headroom? curious how this maps to fractional-GPU prewarm.
mohammed: sure — simulation we ran locally:
```
python tools/simulate_headroom.py --model llm-small --arrival-profile short-chats.json \
  --warmup-policy dynamic --kv-cache-enabled true --runs 1000
```
results: median tokens/sec per-GPU 5.1k, 95th 6.9k, warmup-waste ~18% for this mix.
priyaa: cost impact estimate if we add 10% prewarmed fractional GPUs in eu-west?
jason: rough calc: +10% capacity buys ~25% reduction in tail queuing for short chats due to lower warmup; cost +7% monthly GPU-hours. happy to run more precise bucketing.
elaine: can we instead tune routing to steer short chats to dedicated small-chat pool during shoulder? less constant cost.
priyaa: routing is ideal but needs rollout window. business wants minimal SLA jitter for EU customers this quarter.
mohammed: two proposed mitigations:
- daytime: enable fractional prewarm for small-chat pool in eu-west (10% target)
- routing: add a cheap classifier rule in front to route <128-token requests to small-chat pool
both combined should cut warmup-waste and tail tokens/sec variance.
elaine: agree on combined. start with classifier toggle + metric dashboards, then prewarm if still noisy.
jason: I'll add a lightweight canary for the classifier rule (traffic split 1%). deploy-bot: canary created — canary-id cny-042, route-rule small-chat-short-tokens, start 1718203600.
priyaa: if canary looks good, what's the rollback plan?
jason: rollback = disable canary route + drain pods, metric check for 10 minutes. deployment playbook updated in /runbooks/warmup-routing.md (internal link).
mohammed: scheduling a 30m sync at 08:15 UTC to review canary metrics. I'll post the dashboard link when live :eyes:
elaine: thanks — please include cost delta and 95th latency by pod. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary finished health check at 1718203940 — metrics passing (error-rate <0.1%, avg-latency unchanged).
